title: Robust Feature Scaling and Statistical Imputation Pipeline
patch:
diff --git a/ml/pipeline.py b/ml/pipeline.py
index 30312dd..fa6e550 100644
--- a/ml/pipeline.py
+++ b/ml/pipeline.py
@@ -21,3 +21,9 @@ class FeaturePipeline:
 
     def fit_transform(self, X: Sequence[Sequence[Any]]) -> list[list[float]]:
         return self.fit(X).transform(X)
+
+    def inverse_transform(self, X: Sequence[Sequence[Any]]) -> list[list[Any]]:
+        cur = X
+        for name, transformer in reversed(self.steps):
+            cur = transformer.inverse_transform(cur)
+        return cur
diff --git a/ml/scaler.py b/ml/scaler.py
index 886f79d..8ac3d58 100644
--- a/ml/scaler.py
+++ b/ml/scaler.py
@@ -30,8 +30,9 @@ class RobustScaler:
             med = self._percentile(col, 0.5)
             q25 = self._percentile(col, 0.25)
             q75 = self._percentile(col, 0.75)
-            # BUG: Division by zero when IQR is 0, should default iqr to 1.0
             iqr = q75 - q25
+            if iqr == 0:
+                iqr = 1.0
             self.medians.append(med)
             self.iqrs.append(iqr)
         return self
